instruction:
Use ANSYS Mechanical APDL via the Command Line Interface (CLI) to complete a harmonic response analysis.

Physical problem:
A cantilever beam is subjected to a harmonic force at its free end.

Coordinate system and geometry:
- Use the global Cartesian coordinate system.
- Model the beam as a line body using BEAM188.
- The beam reference line is along the global X direction.
- The fixed end is at X = 0 mm.
- The free end is at X = 500 mm.
- The beam cross section is rectangular:
  - Width = 10 mm
  - Height = 10 mm

Model parameters:
- Beam length: 500 mm
- Element type: BEAM188
- Section type: rectangular beam section
- Section size: 10 mm × 10 mm
- Mesh: 20 uniform divisions along the beam length
- Material: Structural Steel
- Use a consistent N-mm-s unit system:
  - Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa
  - Poisson's ratio ν = 0.3
  - Density ρ = 7.85e-9 tonne/mm³, equivalent to 7850 kg/m³

Boundary conditions and load:
- Fixed end at X = 0 mm:
  - Fully constrain UX, UY, UZ, ROTX, ROTY, and ROTZ.
- Free end at X = 500 mm:
  - Apply a harmonic force with magnitude 10 N.
  - Force direction: negative global Y direction.
  - Excitation frequency: 5 Hz.
- Use no damping, or use a damping ratio smaller than 0.001.

Analysis type:
- Harmonic response analysis.
- Use the Full method.
- Solve a single frequency point at 5 Hz.
- Save the harmonic response result.

Save requirements:
- Use C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop as the ANSYS working directory.
- Save the database file as:
  C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\apdl_harmonic.db
- Save the structural result file as:
  C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\apdl_harmonic.rst
